subject.title: TUI: Support Shift+Enter for newline (Enter to send)

question: Should this issue be completed as docs/help for the existing pi-tui multiline behavior, or should OpenClaw add a configurable TUI send/newline keybinding contract?
rationale: Current main already supports basic multiline composition through pi-tui, but the requested configurable behavior would add a new config/CLI surface under OpenClaw's high config-surface bar.

options.title: Document current behavior first
options.body: Update TUI docs and `/help` to show Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal caveats, and the backslash-Enter fallback without adding config surface yet.

options.title: Add keybinding configuration
options.body: Expose a TUI keybinding preference and tests for Enter/newline/send behavior, accepting the compatibility and migration review cost.

options.title: Split config to a new design item
options.body: Close the docs/help gap here and track configurable send shortcuts separately across TUI and WebChat.

recommendation.title: Document current behavior first
recommendation.body: Update TUI docs and `/help` to show Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal caveats, and the backslash-Enter fallback without adding config surface yet.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter already reviewed this issue into the current remaining product scope and has recent TUI/docs history.
